Built for multitaskers, this 7-in-1 USB-C hub covers everything from ultra-fast data transfer to high-definition video output.
Extend your workspace across two screens at 1080p@60Hz. It is an easy way to raise productivity and work on several tasks at once.
A 10Gbps port moves large files quickly and cuts transfer times dramatically.
With 100W input and 85W output, the hub charges power-hungry devices while you work. A wall charger is not included.

Supports USB-C, USB4 and Thunderbolt connections and works with MacBook (macOS 12 and newer), Windows 10 and 11, ChromeOS and laptops with DP Alt Mode and Power Delivery. It is not compatible with Linux.
Anker USB-C Hub (7-in-1, Dual Display), welcome guide and a 12-month warranty.
